annotations.title: Convert director and cast lines into credits

description: Turn a film's plain director and cast text lines into credit rows (Director for the director line, Actor for each comma-separated cast name), appended after the existing credits, and clear the lines — the film editor's convert button. Nothing is linked or invited; use update_film_credit afterwards. Returns the full credit list.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).
